statement: 本批由辅助调度器实现，非独立实现方；验收须由他方完成。
purpose: Record the prompt version and both prompt digests that BATCH-28's v3 stability runs ran under, together with the values they supersede. The v2 manifest is a separate artifact and was deliberately not rewritten; BATCH-11's own prompt-manifest.json remains BATCH-11's historical record and is untouched.

supersedes.note: that file still records the v2 pair and is left byte-identical; this file is a new sibling artifact rather than an edit of it

superseded_prompt_sha256.note: the schema_repair digest is unchanged from v2 to v3 because the approved increment applies to the candidate prompt only

hash_method.what_is_hashed: sha256 of the prompt string as the module holds it (UTF-8), i.e. prompt_manifest()['candidate_prompt_sha256'] and ['schema_repair_prompt_sha256']
hash_method.self_check: the v1 pair recorded by BATCH-11's manifest was re-derived from the committed v1 module and reproduced exactly before the method was used on v2 and v3

why_the_version_was_bumped.trigger: under v2 the model still traced only observations: across two independent rounds 9 of 12 real attempts repeated MISSING_FIELD_TRACE, leaving criterion 1 reachable but unreliable (~25%)
why_the_version_was_bumped.increment_added: the verbatim worked example from reports/batches/BATCH-28/REPAIR_REPORT.md:362-378, inserted into CANDIDATE_EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT: with three observations and one candidate promise, source_trace MUST contain exactly four entries; the fourth is required even when observations[2] already quotes the same agent sentence, because an observation trace never satisfies the promise trace
why_the_version_was_bumped.placeholders_only: the worked example uses <id> placeholders and generic a/b/c observations; it carries no case content and cannot induce a case-specific answer
retained_from_v2: the JSON example with three concrete indices and no "or"
the disambiguation sentence "Emit one source_trace entry per observation and one per candidate promise; a single entry never covers two fields."
why_the_version_was_bumped.settings_sync_requirement: covenia_b.runtime:589 compares settings.model_prompt_version with prompt_manifest()['prompt_version'], so backend/src/covenia_b/settings.py:56 was moved to candidate-extraction-v3 in the same commit
why_the_version_was_bumped.scope_discipline: source_validation.py was not touched: the validator is correct and stays strict. model_bound_ms was not touched. The schema_repair prompt keeps the v2 sentence only, because the worked example was authorised for the candidate prompt.

commit.subject: fix(prompt): add the worked example so promise traces are emitted reliably
commit.author: aux-dispatcher <aux@local>

acceptance_bar: product owner set >=6 consecutive live passes with image observations kept in every run

observed_in_live_runs.COVENIA_MODEL_PROMPT_VERSION: NOT_SET (the new default was exercised on purpose)
observed_in_live_runs.result: 6 of 6 consecutive PASS, every run accepted on its FIRST attempt, image observations kept in every run (image_observation_count=3, IMAGE traces=3), cached_result=false, revision qwen3-vl-plus-2025-12-19, model_bound_ms 6631-7327 ms against the frozen 20 s budget
observed_in_live_runs.determinism_note: under v2 the same instrument accepted roughly 1 run in 4 and often needed the repair retry; under v3 all six runs were accepted on the first attempt
